description: The BitLocker® Dump Filter (dumpfve.sys) is the full volume encryption filter that resides in the system dump stack. Whenever the dump stack is called (in the event of a system crash or for hibernation), this filter ensures that all data is encrypted before it gets written to the disk as a dump file or hibernation file.
